AI Search / GEO.what_happened: AI’s share of US desktop webpage visits grew roughly 34% year over year, but still doesn’t come close to Search That’s…

sources.name: Kevin_Indig
sources.excerpt: AI’s share of US desktop webpage visits grew roughly 34% year over year, but still doesn’t come close to Search That’s what stood out to me in this chart from SparkToro’s Q2 2026 State of Search report. AI tools accounted for 1.83% of all US desktop webpage visits, but traditional search is almost 6x larger! The chart gives us little support for the claim that AI’s growth is coming at search’s expense. It also shows why growth rates alone make a poor basis for budget decisions. AI is growing quickly from a small base. Search still accounts for a much larger share of visits. I’d use this as a reason to fund AI visibility experiments and keep evaluating search investment against the business…
sources.author: @Kevin_Indig
